subject: HelixAI MAP: capacity runway & GPU pool sizing
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj@helixai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: HelixAI MAP: capacity runway & GPU pool sizing

Marcus / Ben / Neha,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the model latency profile looked promising. We want to draft a short MAP focused on capacity reservation and an accelerated eval so we can hit GA internal testing by Q2. Key asks from our side:

- Lead time expectations for Dedicated + Private (VPC) reservations (H100/other options).
- Recommended GPU pool sizing for our projected 300 RPS inference peak (90th percentile).
- Contingency lanes if shipments slip (tranche plan / canary pool).

I've attached a draft MAP and our internal cadence (Helix_MAP_Request_v0.xlsx). Could you propose 2 MAP options:
1) Fast lane: commit to a small tranche now, scale if eval meets perf
2) Conservative lane: staggered tranches aligned to procurement windows

Can we aim to finalize the MAP and a mutual evaluation checklist by Jan 22?

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Head of ML Ops, HelixAI
raj@helixai.com

Attachment: Helix_MAP_Request_v0.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@helixai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelixAI MAP: capacity runway & GPU pool sizing

Hi Raj — great to connect. Shared a short capacity options brief (redwood_capacity_options_v2.pdf) — see attached. High level proposal:

Summary (two lanes):

1) Acceleration lane (recommended for Q2 GA):
- Commit: 8 H100-equivalent GPUs reserved (dedicated pool) for 12-week eval window
- Acceptance: automated perf gate (p95 latency under 120ms) + correctness sampling
- Lead time: ~6-8 weeks to provision Dedicated tranche (we can fast-path to 4 weeks with an allocation fee + prioritized scheduling)
- Canary: 2-GPU canary pool (private) spun up within 10 business days for smoke tests

2) Phased lane (lower risk):
- Commit: staggered tranches (4 -> 8) aligned to procurement windows (12 week between tranches)
- Lead time: standard 8-12 weeks per tranche for Dedicated; Private on-prem may add 2-4 weeks for networking/KMS work

Sizing rationale:
- For 300 RPS peak, our serving estimates show 8 H100-eq GPUs with optimized batching and KVcache will cover steady-state with room for 20% headroom. If you have large prompt lengths, we should size up by ~25%.

Action items:
- Raj: confirm which lane you prefer and whether Helix can accept a 4-week fast-path fee for the acceleration lane.
- Ben: draft procurement cadence and pricing for a 12-week reserved tranche + fast-path fee.
- Neha: capture SOC2/manual evidence requirements tied to Private deployment (KMS / audit logs).

If we can lock lane preference by Jan 22, we can target a prototype canary within 10 business days and a gated eval start in early Feb.

Best,
Marcus Lin
VP, Platform Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_capacity_options_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj@helixai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelixAI MAP: capacity runway & GPU pool sizing

Marcus / Raj — quick ops notes from my side:

- Procurement timeline: if Helix signs the 12-week tranche today, ops can lock the Dedicated tranche in 6 weeks (standard) or 3-4 weeks with the fast-path fee + PO. We'll need a signed MSA + statement of work covering the tranche sizing and acceptance gates.
- Canaries: recommend the canary pool be run in Helix's VPC with Private control-plane; that avoids data egress for sensitive traffic. We'll provide a short runbook for smoke tests (attach when MAP finalized).
- Risk: If hardware shipments slip, contingency path is to fall back to compatible GPU variants (e.g., A100 -> H100 mix) with a small perf delta. We can include an explicit fallback table in the MAP with expected p95 changes.

Proposal: I'll draft the procurement checklist and a short SOW addendum by Jan 21 for Marcus to review.

Ben
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: HelixAI MAP: capacity runway & GPU pool sizing — approval for fast-path cadence

Folks — forwarding the thread. Raj indicated Helix prefers the Acceleration lane and is open to the fast-path fee if we can guarantee a canary within 10 business days. I need approval to proceed with the discounted fast-path cadence (we should preserve margin).

Key ask for leadership/procurement:
- Approve 4-week fast-path (down from 6-8) for a 12-week reserved tranche at 8 H100-eq GPUs. Proposed commercial terms: 15% fast-path fee upfront, standard tranche pricing thereafter.
- Approve SOW template language for fallback to mixed GPU variants and explicit perf deltas.

If approved, Ben will send the PO checklist + SOW addendum to Raj by EOD Jan 22 and Neha will confirm SOC2 evidence timeline for Private deployment.

Thanks,
Marcus
VP, Platform Sales — Redwood Inference
